content_text: Let’s say you already have a 24mm wide-angle lens on a full-frame camera for those rolling shots of the car. But for everything else—like exterior shots from a distance or those detailed, close-up beauty shots of the car’s interior or specific parts—what lens would you pick? I thought about something in the middle like 50 mm on fullframe? Some People say 16-35 mm but i think it distorts the car a lot. thank you
